test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In an isosceles triangle, if the unequal side is 8 cm and equal side is 5 cm, then the area of the triangle is :
solution:
Given:

Length of each equal sides of isosceles triangle = 5 cm

Length of base of isosceles triangle = 8 cm

Formula:

Area of isosceles triangle = [b/4] × √(4a² – b²)

b = base of isosceles triangle

a = each equal side

Calculation:

Area of isosceles triangle = [8/4] × √(4 × 5² – 8²)

⇒ 2 × √(100 – 64)

⇒ 2 × √36

⇒ 2 × 6

⇒ 12 cm²

∴ Area of isosceles triangle is 12 sq. cm.
